# CurrentTime

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Time & Date](Language-Features-Time-and-Date)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CurrentTime:String
```

**Returns:** The time as text.

## Description

Returns the time of day from the system clock as `HH:MM:SS` on a 24 hour clock.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "It is " + CurrentTime$()
```
